phase_name: Agronomic Gate and Verification Provenance Closure

finding_1_ph_hard_exclusion_contradictio.summary: Reconciled all pH exclusions with Phase 3C.4 approved rules. At pH 8.6, Pulses fail Tier 1 due to biological nodulation arrest; Maize, Cotton, Sugarcane, Tomato, Onion, Banana, Mango, Sunflower, Potato, Rice, Barley PASS Tier 1 with WARNING_ONLY and receive Tier 2 soft penalties. At pH 9.0, Barley and Cotton pass Tier 1; all others fail. At pH 9.2, all 19 crops fail Tier 1 triggering NO_RECOMMENDATION_SUITABLE with Gypsum Advisory.

finding_2_stcr_calibration_verification.summary: Boolean flag alone rejected as fabricated claim. Implemented structured STCRCalibrationRecord with multi-field validation (crop, region, target yield range, coefficients, publication reference, VALIDATED status). Missing or mismatched calibrations fall back to BASELINE_RDF_ARITHMETIC. Valid calibration produces VERIFIED_STCR_GENERATED with polynomial doses and DAP credit.

finding_3_provenance_verification_tiers.summary: Formalized 6 epistemic provenance tiers (INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED, SOURCE_REFERENCED, USER_DECLARED, ESTIMATED, PROVISIONAL, UNKNOWN). Self-declared strings (Certified_Lab, IMD_Station_Gridded) alone yield USER_DECLARED. Physical instrument/station/sample IDs required for INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED. Zero silent upgrades.
